On September 28, 2026, StandardAero, Inc. (the “ Company ”) announced that Kimberly Ernzen will no longer serve as Chief Operating Officer of the Company, effective as of September 28, 2026 (the “ Transition Date ”). Ms. Ernzen will remain employed by the Company and support the Company’s leadership transition efforts from the Transition Date through December 31, 2026. The Company expects to enter into a transition agreement with Ms. Ernzen, the terms of which have not yet been determined. The Company intends such forward-looking statements to be covered by the safe harbor provisions for forward-looking statements contained in Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended. They include statements regarding the expected timing of the leadership transition and the terms of Ms. Ernzen’s transition agreement.
